slots.jd.dental-practice.about:
About us and the job
Linden Park Dental is an owner-run dental practice in Dayton, OH. We are looking for an office assistant to keep the front office running smoothly. This job is on site. You will greet patients, keep schedules in order and help with the paperwork that keeps a small practice going. We are a close team, and we will show you how we do things.
slots.jd.dental-practice.duties:
What the job involves
- Manage schedules for the practice managers, including meetings and appointments
- Process staff expense reports and check receipts before they are submitted
- File patient and office paperwork so records are easy to find
- Keep office records up to date and remove outdated files on a regular basis
- Help at the front desk when patients arrive or call
slots.jd.dental-practice.needs:
What you need
- At least 1 year of experience in an office or front desk role
- Visitor reception skills and a friendly, calm manner with patients
- Calendar management and travel booking for managers
- Vendor coordination and invoice processing
- Daily working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook
- Office Administration Certificate (required)
slots.r1.b1: Schedules meetings and appointments for managers using a shared Microsoft Excel tracker, cutting double bookings by 15 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Arranges travel and event logistics for staff through Microsoft Outlook, sending confirmations and calendar invites ahead of each trip or meeting.
slots.r1.b3: Processes staff expense reports and handles vendor coordination to resolve missing receipts, reducing report turnaround time by 35 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Takes notes at team meetings and applies consistent document formatting so action items are clear and easy to file.
slots.r1.i1: Supports managers at Stonebridge Community Trust by keeping their schedules, meetings and appointments organized.
slots.r1.i2: Handles travel and event arrangements for staff at Stonebridge Community Trust, from booking details to meeting setup.
slots.summary.1: Associate-level administrative support professional with about 1 year of experience handling routine office requests, with a colleague reviewing the work. Skilled in visitor reception, expense reporting and tracking data in Microsoft Excel.
slots.summary.2: Administrative support professional with about 1 year of experience covering visitor reception and day-to-day office requests at an associate level. Handles expense reporting and spreadsheet updates in Microsoft Excel, with a colleague checking the work before it is finalized.
